props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the popup along the anchor's edge: `'start'`, `'center'`, or `'end'`.

props.name: autocomplete
props.description:
Native `autocomplete` attribute of the search input. In `MultiSelect` the input exists only
when `search` or `createItem` is set.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: clearable
props.description:
Shows a clear button while there are selected values or search text. Clearing removes every
selected value except those of disabled items, empties the search text, calls `onClear`,
and returns focus to the control.

props.name: clearIcon
props.description: Icon of the clear button.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description:
Whether `Escape` closes the popup. When `false` the popup stays open and `onClosePrevented`
is called instead.

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description:
Whether an outside interaction, pointer press or focus moving elsewhere, closes the popup.
When `false` the popup stays open and `onClosePrevented` is called instead. Tabbing out of
the control still closes it.

props.name: createItem
props.description:
Creates an item from free text. It is called with the trimmed text when the user commits
text that matches no existing item by label or value (ignoring case and accents), by
pressing `Enter`, completing a token separator, pasting, or calling `create` from
`emptyRender`. The returned item (its `value` must be a string or number) is selected and
added to the top of the option list until the form is reset. Nothing is created once
`maxCount` is reached or when the value is already selected. Providing it also enables the
editable search input, like `search`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial popup state when `open` is not set.

props.name: defaultSearchValue
props.description: Initial search text when `searchValue` is not set.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Initial selected values when `value` is not set. Read once on creation; a native form reset
restores it.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: emptyRender
props.description:
Content shown in the popup when no item matches the search text or `items` is empty. A
function receives `{ searchValue, hasMatches, selectedValues, isAtMaxCount, create, close }`,
where `create(value?)` runs `createItem` for `value` (default: the current search text) and
returns whether an item was added. Defaults to the `create` translation (`Press Enter to
create “text”`) when `createItem` is set and text was typed, otherwise to the `empty`
translation.

props.name: filterMethod
props.description:
How items are matched against the search text; filtering runs only while the text is not
empty. The named strategies compare the item's plain-text label (see `getItemLabel`)
ignoring case and accents using the active locale. A predicate receives the search text and
the item (string items arrive as `{ value, label }`) and returns whether the item stays
visible; it replaces the built-in matching. `false` always shows every item (use it when you
filter on the server). Groups with no visible items are hidden. In `MultiSelect`, filtering
applies only when `search` or `createItem` is set.

props.name: flip
props.description:
Whether to flip placement when the preferred side lacks space. `false` disables flipping. A
string is a space-delimited list of fallback placements tried in order, each `top`,
`bottom`, `left`, or `right` optionally followed by `-start` or `-end` (for example
`'top bottom-end'`); an invalid entry throws.

props.name: getItemLabel
props.description:
Plain-text label of an item, used for typeahead, filtering, form values, and plain-text
displays such as an input value or tag title; does not change rendered labels.
Defaults to the string `label`, otherwise `String(value)`. In `Select` and `Combobox`,
string items arrive as `{ value, label }`.

props.name: gutter
props.description: Gap in pixels between anchor and popup.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's main focusable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to
with `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's related parts (hidden
input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it unique on the page.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Optional editable inner input element ref. Not assigned in non-editable mode.

props.name: isItemDisabled
props.description:
Extra disabled rule, evaluated for every item together with the current selected values;
return `true` to disable the item in addition to `item.disabled`. Disabled items cannot be
selected, highlighted, or reached by typeahead. In `MultiSelect`, a selected disabled item
keeps its tag (it cannot be removed) and survives clearing. In `Select` and `Combobox`,
string items arrive as `{ value, label }`.

props.name: itemProps
props.description:
Returns extra attributes spread on each item row, computed per item from the same state as
`itemRender`. `class`, `style`, `ref`, and the `onClick`, `onPointerMove`, and `onPointerDown`
handlers are merged with the component's own; calling `event.preventDefault()` in `onClick`
stops the selection. `id`, `tabIndex`, `aria-selected`, and `aria-disabled` stay
component-owned.

props.name: itemRender
props.description:
Replaces the default content of every item row (icon, label, description, and selected
check). The row element itself (`role="option"`, click and hover handling) stays owned by the
component. Receives `{ item, selected, highlighted, disabled }`; for `Select` and `Combobox`
string items arrive as `{ value, label }`. Declare the parameter even when unused: a
zero-argument function is called as an accessor, not mounted as a component.

props.name: items
props.description:
Options of the popup list: item objects (no string shorthand), optionally grouped with
`{ type: 'group', label, items }` and divided with `{ type: 'separator' }`. Item values must
be unique across the whole collection; a repeated value is ignored and logs an error in
development. Items created through `createItem` are added on top of this list.

props.name: leading
props.description: Icon rendered before the tags and input.

props.name: listboxProps
props.description:
Extra attributes spread on the listbox `div` inside the popup, such as `aria-label`, `data-*`
or an `onScroll` handler (calling `event.preventDefault()` there skips `onBottomReached`).
`id` and `tabIndex` stay component-owned.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Replaces the toggle icon with `loadingIcon`, and disables the toggle button and marks it
`aria-busy`. Typing and the clear button keep working in the editable input.

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Icon shown instead of `trailing` while `loading`.

props.name: maxCount
props.description:
Maximum number of selected values. Once reached, unselected options are disabled and typed
text is not committed; selected ones can still be removed. It does not truncate a larger
`value`.

props.name: maxVisible
props.description:
Maximum number of tags rendered in the control. The remaining selected values collapse into
a `+N` summary, or into `tagOverflowRender`. The selection itself is unaffected. `0` hides
every tag; unlimited when omitted.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: onBottomReached
props.description:
Called once each time scrolling brings the listbox within `scrollThreshold` of its end,
for example to load the next page. It fires again only after the user scrolls away from the
bottom and back.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called once after a clear action (see `clearable`), following `onValueChange`.

props.name: onClosePrevented
props.description:
Called, without arguments, when `Escape` or an outside interaction was blocked by
`closeOnEscape={false}` or `closeOnOutsideClick={false}`. The popup remains open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Called with the next state whenever the popup should open or close (typing, arrow keys,
selecting an item, `Escape`, `Tab`, or an outside press). Not called when the state would not
change. A disabled select never opens.

props.name: onReset
props.description:
Called after a native `<form>` reset has restored the initial selection (and, in `Combobox`
and `MultiSelect`, cleared the search text). It runs in a microtask after the `reset` event
and is skipped when the event was default-prevented. In controlled mode the selection stays
at `value`, so use this callback to reset your own state.

props.name: onSearchValueChange
props.description:
Called with the new search text when it changes, including the component's own resets to
`''`. The text is already truncated to `searchMaxLength`. During IME composition it fires
once the composition ends.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the full new array of selected values when the user adds or removes an item
(clicking an option, `Enter`, removing a tag, or clearing). The search text is cleared
afterwards. Not called for prop updates or while disabled or read-only.

props.name: open
props.description:
Controlled popup state. `undefined` keeps it uncontrolled. In controlled mode the popup
opens or closes only when you update this prop in `onOpenChange`. Page scrolling is locked
while the popup is open.

props.name: openOnControlClick
props.description:
Whether a pointer click on the control (outside its buttons) opens the popup. Defaults
to `false` when editable (`search` or `createItem` set) and `true` otherwise. Typing
non-blank text, `ArrowDown`, and the toggle button open it regardless.

props.name: overflowPadding
props.description: Viewport collision padding in pixels.

props.name: placeholder
props.description:
Text shown in the control while no value is selected: a label in the non-editable control,
or the input placeholder when editable. Hidden as soon as there is a tag.

props.name: placement
props.description:
Preferred side of the anchor (the control) on which the popup opens. Combined with `align`;
see `flip` for when the side can change.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: removeIcon
props.description: Icon used by tag remove buttons.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: scrollThreshold
props.description: Distance from the end of the listbox, in pixels, within which `onBottomReached` fires.

props.name: search
props.description:
Adds an editable input to the control so typing filters the options, using `filterMethod`.
It is also enabled implicitly by `createItem`. When neither is set the control is a
non-editable trigger: there is no input, and `filterMethod` and `autocomplete` have no
effect.

props.name: searchMaxLength
props.description:
Maximum number of characters in the search text. Applied as the input's `maxLength` and by
truncating text the user commits; a controlled `searchValue` is not truncated. Unlimited when
omitted.

props.name: searchValue
props.description:
Controlled search text. `undefined` keeps the text uncontrolled. The component also resets
the text to `''` when the popup finishes closing, after a native form reset, and (in
`MultiSelect`) after the selection changes; in controlled mode these resets are reported
through `onSearchValueChange('')` and you decide whether to apply them.

props.name: shift
props.description: Cross-axis offset in pixels from the resolved placement.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: slide
props.description: Whether the popup may slide along its main axis to remain visible.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: tagOverflowRender
props.description:
Content shown in place of the default `+N` summary when `maxVisible` hides tags. A
function receives `{ count, tags }`, where `tags` are the hidden entries in selection order.

props.name: tagRender
props.description:
Replaces the default tag (label plus remove button) of each visible tag. Receives
`{ item, value, label, remove }`; `item` is `undefined` for a selected value that matches
no item. Provide your own control that calls `remove()`, which does nothing for disabled
items.

props.name: tokenSeparators
props.description:
Strings that commit completed input tokens through `createItem` or an exact source match,
while typing or pasting into the editable input. Duplicate separators are ignored and
overlapping separators prefer the longest match.

props.name: trailing
props.description:
Icon of the toggle button that opens and closes the popup; replaced by `loadingIcon` while
`loading`.

props.name: translations
props.description:
Overrides the built-in messages for this instance, merged over the messages from the
provider and locale: `clear`, `loading`, `toggle`, `empty`, `placeholder`, `overflow`,
`create`, and `remove`. `overflow({ count })`, `create({ value })`, and `remove({ title })`
are functions returning the text.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled array of selected item values, in selection order. `undefined` keeps the
selection uncontrolled; `[]` keeps it controlled and empty. In controlled mode the
selection changes only when you update this prop in `onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the component.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description:
Renders only the visible rows, such as `createListVirtualizer()` from `moraine/virtualizer`
typed over `ComboboxT.Row`. Rows include group labels and separators. The listbox is the
scroll container, items get `aria-posinset` and `aria-setsize`, and keyboard highlight scrolls
through the virtualizer. Not available on `Select`.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary text rendered under the label in the default item content. Ignored when `itemRender` is set.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this item cannot be selected. A disabled item is also left out of form submission.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon rendered before the label in the default item content. Ignored when `itemRender` is set.

props.name: label
props.description:
Visual label. May be any JSX; when it is not a string, plain-text uses (typeahead,
filtering) fall back to `String(value)` unless `getItemLabel` is set.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique selection and form value. Values compare by identity, so `1` and `'1'` differ.
